expectations.buyer: Media publishers, generative-AI platforms, camera and editing vendors, brand-safety teams, and provenance programme owners
expectations.pain: Content credentials or watermarks disappear, become misleading, or fail to bind after real editing, transcoding, social distribution, and recomposition pipelines
expectations.strongestIncumbent: C2PA conformance tools and trust lists, Content Credentials Verify, vendor SDK test suites, watermark benchmarks, media QA, and platform upload tests
expectations.biggestRisk: Open conformance tools and platform-owned testing may absorb the product, provenance is not truth, invisible watermark performance is vendor-specific, and buyers may not control downstream transformations
